requirements.requirement_text: **Decision:** Keep SaaS Core/Hono, Queue producer and small Cloudflare Push Consumer on **TypeScript** by default. Use a separately built **native Rust executable** as the preferred new long-running `job-supervisor` and native I/O executor outside Cloudflare Workers. Go remains a qualified alternate executor implementation, not a mandatory dependency; Rust is not mandatory for every job. Retain Python OpenAI Agents SDK, Codex/Runner and FFmpeg/GPU/provider-specific executors. A thin Rust/Wasm Worker using `workers-rs` MAY be benchmarked for focused Cloudflare bindings, but SHALL NOT be substituted for a native multi-hour process and SHALL NOT enlarge the default TS Queue worker merely to share language.

Queue delivery is at least once. Reliability SHALL be defined by durable admission, idempotency, canonical state, recovery ownership and measured backup/restoration, not programming-language marketing.

For long jobs, ACK may follow durable DB claim + reconcilable handoff, **only if** the recovery scanner is implemented and tested; never ACK based merely on process spawning. requirements.requirement_text: **Normative owner directive:** ALL development of the new SmartSIHub platform SHALL be initiated, orchestrated, observed and accepted through the *currently running* `https://smartaihub.app` Autonomous Implements / Autonomous Mini App Creator facilities, using their existing SPEC-224 Job/Run, Runner, Workspace, Harness and deployment authorities. `smartaihub.app` is the **temporary development control plane**, not the new SaaS Core implementation or the new production domain. An emergency out-of-band repair is permitted ONLY when the old UI/control path is nonfunctional; reconcile its exact SHA/Run/receipts back into the canonical record as soon as recovery permits. The new autonomous implementer becomes the primary authority only after it has completed real development tasks and recovery/rollback tests; user-visible traffic switches selectively, with the old tool retained as fallback until stable.
